items.distractor_fact: Stacioni në fshatin fqinj regjistroi {D}°C po atë mëngjes.
items.gloss_en: The station in the neighboring village recorded {D} °C that same morning.
items.entity_note: a different village's own station, not the morning/afternoon thermometer the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Një kompani tjetër e regjistruar në të njëjtën bursë mbylli ditën me çmim ${D}.
items.gloss_en: Another company listed on the same exchange closed the day at ${D}.
items.entity_note: a different company's stock, not the one whose open and close prices are compared

items.distractor_fact: Rezervuari në komunën fqinje kishte një nivel uji prej {D}m po atë muaj.
items.gloss_en: The reservoir in the neighboring municipality had a water level of {D} m that same month.
items.entity_note: a different reservoir, not the one whose level this month vs last month is compared

items.distractor_fact: Një dron tjetër, i nisur nga po ai aeroport, arriti një lartësi prej {D}m atë ditë.
items.gloss_en: Another drone, launched from the same airport, reached an altitude of {D} m that day.
items.entity_note: a different drone, not the one whose initial and final measurements are compared

items.distractor_fact: Një paketë tjetër në të njëjtin transport peshonte {D}kg në mbërritje.
items.gloss_en: Another package in the same shipment weighed {D} kg on arrival.
items.entity_note: a different package, not the one whose weight before and after shipping is compared

items.distractor_fact: Motori i mjetit tjetër në të njëjtin test arriti një shpejtësi prej {D}km/h.
items.gloss_en: The engine of the other vehicle in the same test reached a speed of {D} km/h.
items.entity_note: a different engine/vehicle, not the one whose initial and final readings are compared

items.distractor_fact: Një lojtar tjetër në të njëjtën seancë mbylli me {D}pts.
items.gloss_en: Another player in the same session finished with {D} pts.
items.entity_note: a different player, not the one whose start/end score is compared

items.distractor_fact: Një klient tjetër i të njëjtës bankë depozitoi ${D} po atë javë.
items.gloss_en: Another client of the same bank deposited ${D} that same week.
items.entity_note: a different client, not the one whose deposit and withdrawal are compared

items.distractor_fact: Një anëtar tjetër i klubit fitoi {D}pts po atë muaj.
items.gloss_en: Another club member earned {D} pts that same month.
items.entity_note: a different member, not the one whose points balance is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Një depo tjetër e të njëjtit zinxhir mori një sasi prej {D} po atë javë.
items.gloss_en: Another warehouse in the same chain received a stock count of {D} that same week.
items.entity_note: a different warehouse, not the one whose stock balance is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Një dyqan tjetër në të njëjtin qendër tregtare pati të ardhura prej ${D} këtë muaj.
items.gloss_en: Another shop in the same mall had income of ${D} this month.
items.entity_note: a different shop, not the one whose net result is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Numri i golave të shënuara nga një ekip tjetër arriti {D} gjatë sezonit.
items.gloss_en: The number of goals scored by another team reached {D} during the season.
items.entity_note: a different team, not the one whose goal difference for the season is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Treni tjetër, në linjën fqinje, mbërriti {D}min pas mesnate.
items.gloss_en: The other train, on the neighboring line, arrived {D} min after midnight.
items.entity_note: a different train on a different line, with its own unstated schedule — not the train whose actual arrival vs its own schedule is compared
